panels.description: Share of consumed Kafka course-log records that were rejected. Consumed records are stream events (by storage time), recommendation-request lines and rejected lines (by receive time). The rolling 15-minute rate is what the alerts use: warning above 10%, critical above 20%, held for 5 minutes, and only when the window has at least 100 consumed records. Null when there is no traffic.

targets.rawSql: WITH buckets AS (SELECT window_end AS time, rejected_total_count::double precision AS rejected, kafka_record_count::double precision AS consumed FROM monitoring_runs WHERE window_end >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND window_end <= CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes'), series AS (SELECT time, rejected, consumed, SUM(rejected) OVER (ORDER BY time RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '10 minutes' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_rejected, SUM(consumed) OVER (ORDER BY time RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '10 minutes' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_consumed FROM buckets) SELECT time, CASE WHEN consumed = 0 THEN NULL ELSE rejected / consumed END AS "5-minute rejection rate", CASE WHEN rolling_consumed < 100 THEN NULL ELSE rolling_rejected / rolling_consumed END AS "Rolling 15-minute rate (alerted)" FROM series WHERE time >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Rejection Rate: 5-Minute and Rolling 15-Minute

panels.description: Total rejected Kafka records across completed five-minute buckets in the last 24 hours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rejected_total_count), 0)::double precision AS "Rejected (24h)" FROM monitoring_runs WHERE window_end > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes'

panels.title: Rejected Records (24h)

panels.description: Rejected records divided by consumed records over the last 24 hours. Null with no traffic.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(rejected_total_count)::double precision / NULLIF(SUM(kafka_record_count), 0) AS "Rejection rate (24h)" FROM monitoring_runs WHERE window_end > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes'

panels.title: Rejection Rate (24h)

panels.description: Rejected Kafka records per completed five-minute bucket, stacked by reason. A jump in malformed or unrecognized lines usually means the upstream log format changed. Individual lines are in the rejected_requests table.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, rejected_invalid_encoding_count::double precision AS "Invalid encoding", rejected_malformed_line_count::double precision AS "Malformed line", rejected_unrecognized_event_count::double precision AS "Unrecognized event", rejected_invalid_user_id_count::double precision AS "Invalid user ID", rejected_invalid_event_time_count::double precision AS "Invalid event time", rejected_invalid_field_count::double precision AS "Invalid field", rejected_unknown_movie_count::double precision AS "Unknown movie" FROM monitoring_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes' ORDER BY window_end

panels.title: Rejections by Reason

panels.description: Kafka course-log records consumed and rejected per completed five-minute bucket, for context on the rejection rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, kafka_record_count::double precision AS "Consumed records", rejected_total_count::double precision AS "Rejected records" FROM monitoring_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes' ORDER BY window_end
